fusions.name: Snapped Sheet
fusions.desc: Snaps a sheet of silk around you, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Winding Shroud
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Throws a shroud that deals 22 damage to it and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Drawn Drapery
fusions.desc: Veils you and every ally near you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Weaver's Coat
fusions.desc: Every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your dodge chance rises by 4%, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
